title: ${\mathrm{ASL}_n}(\mathbb Z)$ invariant random subsets of $\mathbb Z^n$
summary: We classify measures on $\{0,1\}^{\mathbb{Z}^d}$, $d \geq 3$, the space of subsets of $\mathbb{Z}^d$, which are invariant under all affine special linear transformations. In other words, we classify simple point processes on $\mathbb{Z}^d$ whose law is invariant under affine special linear transformations.
